# Remodeling Calculator

> > Comprehensive home remodeling cost estimators and pricing guides for windows, HVAC, flooring, roofing, and kitchen renovations with detailed breakdowns and energy efficiency ratings.

Remodeling Calculator provides detailed cost calculators and installation pricing guides for homeowners planning renovation projects. The site features brand comparisons (Trex, AZEK, LeafGuard), technical specifications (SEER ratings, R-values, BTU), and real-world pricing data across all major home improvement categories.

## Key Topics

- Installation costs and pricing guides
- Energy efficiency (SEER ratings, R-value, BTU)
- Vinyl and replacement windows
- Kitchen remodeling
- HVAC systems and heat pumps
- Flooring installation (engineered hardwood, tile, concrete)
- Composite decking (Trex, AZEK, TimberTech)
- Insulation (spray foam, garage)
- Gutter systems (LeafGuard, Gutter Helmet, Gutter Glove)
- Roofing materials and flat roof systems
- Cost estimators and calculators
- Labor and material cost breakdowns
- Brand comparisons and reviews

## Cost Calculators & Estimators

- [2023  Boiler Installation Cost Calculator - Estimate Boiler Replacement Cost](https://www.remodelingcalculator.org/boiler-cost-calculator): Boiler cost calculator for condensing, hydronic & steam system replacement
- [2023 Window Installation Cost - Estimate The Cost To Install Vinyl Windows](https://www.remodelingcalculator.org/replacement-windows-prices): Vinyl window installation: $300-$400 per window with Low E & Argon options
- [2023 Small Kitchen Remodel Cost](https://www.remodelingcalculator.org/small-kitchen-remodel-cost): Small kitchen remodel costs: $9,500-$14,250 avg, $25k-$35k upscale
